title: Bouillabaisse – Easy Method
preamble:
1½ pints fish stock

1 medium onion, sliced finely

1 tablespoon cream

1 oz crème de riz (or rice flour)

1 glass white wine
ingredients: 1 oz crème de riz (or rice flour)
notes: Butter, salt and pepper on 1 inch slices of salmon. Put each salmon piece in an envelope of foil and bake in oven at Gas Mark 6 for 10 minutes.
Serve and pour a bechemal sauce flavoured with chopped anchovies over fish
